# Black Arrow Venture company

> Critical infrastructure and healthcare solutions provider based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. Supplies, installs and maintains isolated power panels, UPS and critical power systems, EV charging, firefighting systems, HVAC, electrical distribution, lighting, hospital modular operating rooms, and radiation (lead) shielding - plus paid technical consultancy across all of these. Serves Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Al Khobar and the wider Eastern Province, with aviation-sector experience.

Founded 2022. Commercial Registration 7054542985. VAT 314841084500003.
Contact: +966 56 022 4715 - info@blackarrowksa.com
Website: https://www.blackarrowksa.com

Not tied to buying equipment or installation from Black Arrow.

## Black Arrow 3D (3D printing store)

Black Arrow 3D (https://www.blackarrowksa.com/3d/) is an online 3D printer store in Saudi Arabia, run by Black Arrow Venture (Dammam, CR 7054542985). It is separate from the infrastructure services above. English and Arabic (/3d/ar/).

Key facts:
- Sells 3D printers (Bambu Lab A1 mini, A1, A2L, P2S, H2C; Snapmaker U1; Creality SparkX i7; Elegoo Centauri Carbon 2; Anycubic Kobra 3 Max; Flashforge), PLA+/PLA/PETG filament, spare parts, in-house 3D printed gifts, and a custom 3D printing service with an instant online STL quote.
- Ships from Dammam to every city in Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Jeddah, Makkah, Madinah, Dammam, Al Khobar, Jubail, Qassim, Abha, Tabuk and more). In-stock orders placed before 4 pm Sunday to Thursday are dispatched the same day. Standard delivery 4-5 business days (30 SAR), fast 2-3 business days (50 SAR). Free regular delivery on 100 SAR+ of 3D printed items or 3,000 SAR+ of printers.
- Payment: bank transfer, mada, Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, Tabby (pay in 4) and Tamara. A pay-later service fee applies to orders with printers or filament only.
- Prices in SAR including 15% VAT. Manufacturer warranty on printers; the store helps with warranty claims.
- Support in Arabic and English: WhatsApp +966 56 022 4715, info@blackarrowksa.com.
